message_text: This is ridiculous. It is pouring on 880 and the wipers are smearing so badly I can barely make out the lane lines, and the screen keeps flashing a wiper warning at me. I paid a lot of money for this car and I cannot drive it in the rain like this. Somebody needs to call me TODAY. I need this fixed before my commute tomorrow or I am going to lose my mind.

Brake warning came up on the drive in this morning, code BRK_w003. The pedal feels softer than normal and the car needs more distance to stop at lights than it did last week. I have parked it at work and will not drive home on it until someone looks at it. Please tell me the earliest slot you can take it.

Hello, since the cold snap started the cabin heat has stopped working on the passenger side and the screen shows HVAC_w003. The driver side gets lukewarm air at best and the windshield takes ages to clear in the mornings. The car drives fine otherwise. My kids are freezing on the school run, so I would appreciate a visit this week if possible. Thanks, Oluwaseun

Hi there, hope your week is going well. Nothing dramatic, just thought I should mention it. Over the last few days the steering has felt a bit heavier at parking speeds, and on the highway the car wants to drift to the right unless I keep hold of the wheel. I honestly assumed it was the road camber on I-80. I didn't notice anything on the screen. Whenever you have a gap is perfect, I'm retired so I'm flexible.

I have called twice now and nobody is helping me. The music and navigation side of the screen freezes, reboots, comes back for thirty seconds and freezes again, over and over, with UI_a004 flashing. No music, no maps, nothing. The car itself drives normally but this is unacceptable for a car this new and I am honestly furious. I want a technician on this immediately and I want someone senior to call me back.

Calling about an ABS warning, ABS_w002, that came on yesterday after I hit a pothole on Capitol Expressway. This morning on a wet road the pedal pulsed and the car slid a little when I stopped at a light, which has never happened before. I am a bit worried about it. Can you get me in as soon as possible? I can drop it off any time.

Charge port flap won't close after charging at home and the app says CP_a004. I've tried closing it from the app and by hand and it just springs back open. It also wouldn't start charging twice this week until I unplugged and replugged. The car drives totally fine. Can someone come out or should I bring it in? I'm free Thursday or Friday afternoon.

Stopped by after work. There's a rattling noise from behind the dash whenever the fan is above level three, and the air coming out of the vents is weak even on full. The screen showed HVAC_w003 once last week and then cleared. Not urgent, I just want it looked at before summer. I can leave it with you if a loaner is available.

Hi team, just wanted to say the car was fantastic on our weekend trip up to Tahoe. Autopilot made the drive so relaxing and the kids loved camp mode. One small thing I noticed coming back down 50 is that the pedal goes further down than it used to before the car really slows, and there's a faint grinding when I come to a full stop. It's probably just the mountain roads. No rush at all, happy to come in whenever suits you. Thanks again!

Hi, the driver side wiper has started chattering across the glass and leaves a streak right in my line of sight. The screen showed WIP_w001 once on Monday. Washer fluid sprays fine. I suspect the blade just needs replacing but wanted to check whether it is covered. A mobile visit at my office in North San Jose would be ideal. Regards, Samuel Osei

EPAS_a191 popped up on 680 this morning, steering assist reduced. The wheel went really heavy all at once and I had to fight it to change lanes. I pulled off at Alcosta and the car is sitting in a parking lot now. I don't want to drive it like this. What do I do? Can you tow it or get me a slot today?

UNBELIEVABLE. The driver door handle won't pop out again, this is the third time this year. I'm standing in a freezing parking lot in Roseville jabbing at my phone trying to get into my own car. I had to climb in through the passenger side in a work skirt. I'm so done with this. Fix it properly this time or I'm escalating this to whoever I need to.

Good morning, on Tuesday evening in heavy rain I got ESP_w003 on the screen and a few minutes later ABS_w002 as well. Both cleared after the car sat overnight. Just before the first one the back end stepped out slightly on the Mission Blvd on-ramp, which has never happened in this car. I have photos of both messages if useful. Please let me know the first opening at Fremont. Best, Trevor Abernathy

message_subject: Charging stops after a few minutes
message_text: Hi, this is Yuki calling about my Model Y. At Superchargers it starts fine but stops after about five minutes with CP_a004, and at home it only charges at a very slow rate. I can still drive it around town so it's not an emergency, but I have a long drive down to LA on the 17th and need it sorted before then.

Hi, my phone disconnects from the car every ten minutes or so and the screen shows UI_a004 when it happens. Calls drop mid conversation, which is annoying for work. I've already tried forgetting and re-pairing the phone and doing a soft reset. Is there a software fix you can push, or does it need to come in?

Drove straight here from Elk Grove. The red brake alert came on, BRK_a001, and the pedal is going almost to the floor before it grabs. The warning has not cleared after restarting the car. I kept it under 30 the whole way with the hazards on. I'm not comfortable driving it home, so please keep it and I'll get a ride.

Hello, I picked up the car three weeks ago and love it. The front seat heaters switch off after a couple of minutes and the screen has shown HVAC_w003 twice. Defrost also seems slow compared to my old car, though that may just be me. Could someone call me to walk through the settings first, before I book a visit? Thank you, Anjali

The map has been frozen on the same spot since this afternoon even though the car is moving, and UI_a004 is on the screen. Rebooting the screen with the scroll wheels fixed it for ten minutes, then it froze again. Not a big deal, I'm just using my phone for directions for now. Can you check it remotely?
